svg.title: PC-12 INTERIOR ARRANGEMENT - CHECKS
svg.desc: PC12-L6 rev F, -, A1. RECONSTRUCTION FROM PUBLISHED DATA - NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION.

g.text: RECONSTRUCTION FROM PUBLISHED DATA - NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION
CREW STATION - OCCUPANTS AT THEIR SETTINGS (mm)
each picks the knee angle ~120°; crank - = fwd
eye vs design eye, fwd / up
legs to the yoke, pitch ±90, wings
criterion >= 25; 3-D, knees on the hip-to-pedal line
the pedal that comes aft lifts that knee [E travel]
... legs to the yoke, wings level
up-knee on the worse leg, other leg extended; full
crosswind flare: full aft, roll, opposite rudder
the 50th-pct eye on the neutral seat: SRP + 80 fwd / 799 up; L2 used 4080/335/2360
5th female -51 below it at full up (over-nose 4.3°): cushion
eye to own PFD / to MFD
glareshield lip 11° down: clear of the view
lowest / 50th / top lock; divider fwd face 4546
trimmed inboard cushion (symmetric: -30; its top only 29 above the plinth at the lowest fwd
inboard arm face to the PCL grip over the seat travel (lowest seat), >= 10 [E]; the arm's
95th hip 415: hips pass between the headrests, legs between the backs, then over the
inboard cushion with the armrest up (stowed along the back, top 772 above the floor); divider
aft notch: the stowed curtain (LH, 60 deep [E]) to the seat back below its flare top and to the
crew track's aft end; the bottle to the co-pilot seat's back / plate
REACH FROM THE NEARER SHOULDER JOINT (mm)
GRASP (levers, CCD palm grip): straight arm, shoulder joint to thumbtip 740 (95th; 5th F 607), from the thumbtip reach 870 less the back-wall offset.
TOUCH (touch screens, push-buttons, switches, breakers): + 70 to the index fingertip [E] (810 / 664). LOCKED: within it, harness locked; LEAN: within
+200 with the inertia reel unlocked (normal in flight); NO: beyond.
KNEE vs YOKE - SENSITIVITY TO THE ESTIMATED INPUTS (OPEN POINT 1)
Left seat. Each row changes one input from the as-set state; every occupant then re-picks notch and crank (knee ~120° rule, least travel). CONTACT:
yoke roll (full pitch travel) at which a knee first touches a grip, neutral pedals. RUDDER: the up-knee on the pedal that came aft, other leg extended:
wings-level clearance / roll to contact; none = no contact to 90°. EXT. KNEE: at full forward rudder, ! = beyond 165° [E]. HEAD TO DIVIDER: aft notch,
Sheet L6 is drawn from the parameter tables of model/interior.py and the fuselage, openings and glazing parameters (L1-L3), never from the mesh.
Each value carries a source tag: [S] sourced, [M] measured from photos / renders, [E] estimated, [H] hard constraint.
Seat stations: POH NGX Report 02406 weight-and-balance occupant arms (POH datum = model datum). EX-6S-2 is the PRO standard 6-seat
layout: aft-facing club pair, forward-facing club pair, staggered aft pair, forward RH lavatory.
Crew seat: IPECO 3A318-type, travel ±70 in 9 holes (POH), vertical ±51 (est.). Design eye = the 50th-pct eye on the neutral seat = SRP + 80 fwd /
799 up; the 95th (seat down) and 5th male (seat up) reach it. Accommodated range at the design eye as drawn: 5th male - 95th male; the 5th female
Manikins: 95TH-PCT MALE (ANSUR II) (stature 1870, sitting height 975, eye 850), scaled uniformly for the 50th / 5th male and 5th female. Crew:
each sets seat height, notch and pedal crank (knee angle ~120°); feet on the pedals, hands on the grips, knees on the hip-to-pedal line (pedals ±125
[M]); full rudder moves one pedal 80 forward and the other as far aft. Cabin: upright, outboard (TTL), feet flat under the knees unless noted. Sections
A-A / B-B draw what lies forward of the cut (legs, hands) in phantom.
Seat tracks: surface-mounted, 12 cabin / 18 crew [E], over the carry-through too; the seat heights include them.
Lining: headliner 40 below the OML at the crown, sidewall 85, giving the published 1.52 x 1.47 cabin; floor WL 1259 flush from the pedals to the
baggage wall. The pedestal stands on a carpeted plinth over the nose-wheel tunnel (gear, hard).
Stage 2 only: the 3-D interior is still rev A and is rebuilt from these tables after the owner's review.
seats fully outboard (TTL); one arm per seat, inboard; cushion to the ledge 45
feet interleave: PAX 3 at CL ±105, PAX 1 ±225; outer foot -30 to the kick panel
95th / 50th: the 95th's head centre is above the headrest; it supports the 50th
window 1995-2380: eyes above the window top (no seated photo to test)
club table underside vs the legs, 95
top 590 (20 under the ledge cap [M]), feet under the knees: the legs (CL ±105) are
under the top; outboard leaf alone: -45 / -8 / +27 / +58
table: shank angle for 25 / toes to
50th with the feet forward: fits; 95th needs 38° and his feet 125 under the facing
seat's base: does not fit (decision + open point)
deg from vertical, of 45 [E]; limits: 2: lavatory, 3: PAX 5, 6: FR34 partition
PAX 6 back to FR34 / PAX 1 to
exit hatch clear of the PAX 2
facing inboard on the toilet (back at the lid hinge); lav 624 x 492: doors cannot
lav: floor in front of the cabinet
cabinet 365 deep [E] to the bi-fold line (P1046411 shows carpet there)
lav bi-folds to the entry zone
DEVIATION / DECISION (vs the references and rev B)
built from the measured span 285: grips 160 long from -40 below the hub centre, tops 10° inboard (JTF key, P1046408);
rev B: 15° outboard from the hub centre, span unused
keep the measured hub, grips and pedals: the 95th's knee meets a grip from 18° roll (neutral pedals). The outcome
depends on the estimated inputs more than on the measured ones (sensitivity table): the owner is asked which input to fix,
±125 centres, 125 pads, measured face-on (P1046408, MFD bezel scale + depth correction); rev B ±90 / 80 [E]. The crew
knees sit on the hip-to-pedal line + 15 splay: 95th ±126 (rev B ±105)
SRP kept at 4200: the POH arm 4071 is the 50th's CG with the seat full aft (CG table); 60-85 further aft would put the
aft-notch headrest as far into the divider and off the render's cushion front 3720 [M]
surface-mounted 12 [E] over the whole cabin floor (crew 18): over the carry-through the floor is <= 15 [H], too thin for a
flush 20-25 track; local channels in the spar cap would need the structure (not modelled). The cabin seat heights [M] are
read from the carpet and include the track; the seat bases stand on the tracks (B-B)
cabinet 350 tall [M] (0.33 ring as scale; r2 450 [E]), niche 440-640 [M]; the lower seat puts the 95th's knees 226 past the
curtain drawn: track at the headliner, bundle stowed LH (PRO 3001, orange; NGX 2281 stows a grey one RH); fire
extinguisher on the RH divider's fwd face (plan); autoland cup (A-A)
top -130 vs the MFD centre (10-20 under the MFD bezel), reclined 35° (JTF, camera-matched P1046406, P1046408);
drawn 156 tall in view D; rev B -170 / 20°
one armrest, inboard: a deep side panel (base top to 435) with the seat control on its forward end; the 610 ledge is the
outboard armrest; rev B drew two arms
cabinet wall to wall 4600-5165, bowl at the POH arm 4831, shelf + drawer aft of 5040, lit niche, TP holder (P1046411);
keep the measured table (top 590, outboard leaf + unfolding inboard leaf); up to the 50th fits (feet fwd 28°); the 95th does
pedal travel ±80 [E] and the toe brake added; the knee checks pose the up-knee on the aft pedal and the extended leg on
grasp vs touch: touch targets get the 70 fingertip; the 95th reaches the PDUs and SDUs harness locked
in the back's thickness, stowed along the back side; rev B hinged it 125 ahead of the back
render footprint used: 108 aft of the POH-occupant mirror
POH 8180 used; the marketing plan render shows it 180 fwd
moved +56 aft of the render (5244) to clear the airstair opening
4120/375/2338 = the 50th eye on the neutral seat; replaces 3980 (info) and 4080/335/2360 (L2); over-nose 7.6° vs 8.9°
crew seat BL 375 (335; yoke key 372), SRP 280 above the floor (300), vertical ±51 (±40), back 13° (11°), inboard cushion
185 (tunnel plinth); flight-deck floor flush 1259 (1240 + 19 step); MFD WL 2000 (1960; notes 1830; cabin-photo check 2010
±50); hood closed onto the WS frame (plate 80-150 below); CB panels on the sidewall above the consoles (below them);
FR34 veneer header + curtain (net); aft wall 9731 = divider + 5160 (FR36 9750, render 9744)
KNEES vs YOKE: WHICH INPUT TO FIX? With the measured hub, grips and pedals (grip bottoms WL 1805, pedals ±125), the 95th's knee meets a
grip from 18° roll with neutral pedals (50th 25°); with full rudder the 95th touches it wings level (-11) and the 50th from 0°. The estimated inputs move
this more than the measured ones (sensitivity table): knees 30 wider -> 95th neutral contact 68°; a 130° knee target (seat further aft) -> 80°, full rudder
+8, but the 50th's forward rudder needs 173° (> 165°); the hub 50 higher -> none, full-rudder contact from 18°. Please choose what to pin down: the
seat-setting rule (knee target), the knee spacing, the rudder travel, the hub height, or the roll travel / a roll limit. Wanted: the control-wheel roll and
rudder travel (AMM / POH) and a side-on photo of a seated pilot at the yoke.
5TH-FEMALE ACCOMMODATION. At the forward notch, pedals cranked fully aft and the seat full up (+51, the travel limit [E]), her eye is 51 below the
design eye: over the nose 4.3° along her BL (design eye 7.6°), 2.3° along BL 200; full forward rudder straightens her knee to 169° (limit 165° [E]; a 5 ft
2 in pilot, scale 0.84: 150°). As drawn the station accommodates 5th male - 95th male. Options: a booster cushion, more vertical travel (the IPECO
3A318 figure is wanted; ±51 is [E]), or state the range as 5M-95M.
CLUB TABLE. Deployed (top 590, under the ledge cap), the 95th's knees are 45 into it and the 50th's 8 with the feet under the knees (the outboard
leaf alone: the same, the outboard leg is under it). The 50th fits with the feet 28° forward (toes 6 short of the facing seat's base); the 95th would need
38° and put his feet 125 under it. Kept: the table serves up to about the 50th. Confirm, or re-measure the table / ledge height.
Aft-facing club PAX 1/2: plan render (used) or POH-occupant mirror? The render leaves 204 of the 482 exit hatch clear of the PAX 2 cushion; the
mirror gives a 642 club gap (render 534, 95th toes pass 424).
Design eye 4120 / 375 / 2338 (over-nose 7.6°) to replace cockpit_glazing.EYE (L2) and the viewer camera.
Tunnel plinth (gear, 350 wide, 226 tall to STA 4120): the crew cushions are trimmed to 185 inboard to clear it; the photos show symmetric cushions
and no step at the pedestal foot. Can the tunnel end or drop?
Lavatory: cabinet wall to wall, 365 deep [E], leaves 72 of floor to the bi-fold line (BL 260); a seated 95th's knees still reach 226 past it. Door line /
Cabin seated eye above the window top (95th 2462, 50th 2412 vs 2380): a seated-passenger photo would test the cushion 420 / SRP 360 (the
Crew SRP 4200 vs the POH pilot arm 4071: the 50th's CG is -63 from it at the centre notch and -1 with the seat full aft, so the POH arm is read as a
full-aft value and the SRP is kept (the aft-notch headrest is already at the divider). Confirm the POH arm convention; crew seat vertical travel (±51
est.), back / headrest heights (side-on photo), MFD WL; interior scheme and cabin height 1.47 vs 1.45.
Stage-2 parameter tables, checks; review r1
review r2 + r3 (list on sheet 1): sensitivity, CG cross-check, 5th-female point
Stage-3 review r2: sheepskin in the crew outline, yoke grips, curtain / track
Stage-3 review r3: exec legrest, PC-24 yoke face, PCL grip, armrest / pedestal row
Stage-4 final judge r1: yoke shield a full U, grips 160, heads r 18 [M]

POH OCCUPANT ARMS vs THE OCCUPANT CG (mm)
Method: Dempster (1955) segment-mass fractions and segment CG locations (Winter's table) on the sheet's 50th-pct poses, both limbs alike.
Forward-facing cabin seats +21..+21: the method agrees with the POH to ~2 cm. Pilot: -63 at the centre notch but -1 with the seat full aft, so the POH
crew arm reads as a full-aft value (conservative for the aft CG); the SRP stays at 4200 (the divider bounds it: open point 9). Aft-facing PAX 1/2: the
